name: Staff of Winter
body:
Aura moderate varied; CL 10th; Slot none; Price 19,000 gp; Weight 5 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This staff made from the fused vertebrae of a remorhaz’s tail has an ivory coloration and is topped by a small sphere of ice. It allows use of the following spells.

Moguls (1 charge)
Slalom skier (1 charge)
Wall of snow (2 charges)

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Staff; Spells moguls, slalom skier, wall of snow; Cost 9,500 gp.
